# Operations IQ documentation site

The unified documentation site for **Operations IQ**, built with
[Docusaurus 3](https://docusaurus.io/). It hosts three guides:

- **User Guide** (`docs/user/`) — for analysts and operators using the app.
- **Admin Guide** (`docs/admin/`) — for deploying and operating the solution.
- **Developer Guide** (`docs/dev/`) — for engineers extending the solution.

Each guide is a separate Docusaurus docs instance with its own sidebar
(`sidebars/user.ts`, `sidebars/admin.ts`, `sidebars/dev.ts`). Sidebars are
**autogenerated** from the folder structure — ordering comes from
`sidebar_position` frontmatter and `_category_.json` files.

## Run locally

```powershell
cd docs-site
npm install
npm run start   # dev server with live reload at http://localhost:3000
```

## Build

```powershell
npm run build   # outputs static site to docs-site/build
npm run serve   # preview the production build locally
```

> `npm run build` **fails on broken links** (`onBrokenLinks: 'throw'`). Fix any
> reported links before merging.

## Authoring

- **Add a page:** create a Markdown/MDX file in the appropriate guide folder.
  Add frontmatter with `title` and `sidebar_position`.
- **Add a section (category):** create a subfolder with a `_category_.json`
  (label, position, and a `link` to its `index` doc) and an `index.md`.
- **Cross-links:** use absolute doc routes, e.g. `/user/explore/overview`,
  `/admin/configuration`, `/dev/data-model`.
- **Cards:** the `<ModuleCards items={[{title, to, desc}]} />` component is
  available in any MDX file (registered in `src/theme/MDXComponents.tsx`).
- **Admonitions:** use `:::note`, `:::info`, `:::warning`, etc.
- **Diagrams:** fenced ```mermaid``` blocks render as diagrams.
- **Search:** offline local search via `@easyops-cn/docusaurus-search-local`
  (no external service) — it indexes all three guides automatically at build time.

## Deployment — Fabric Apps (Rayfin), private by default

The docs are served as a **separate Fabric App** (`rayfin/rayfin.yml`, app id
`operations-iq-docs`) using Rayfin **static hosting behind Fabric SSO**. This is
a different app from the Operations IQ SPA (`OperationsIQApp/`), so it has its
own URL and lifecycle. Because Fabric SSO gates access, **the docs are private
to your tenant** — anyone viewing them must first sign in with a Fabric
identity.

### Prerequisites

- The **Fabric Apps (Rayfin)** workload enabled in your tenant.
- The Rayfin CLI (installed as a devDependency here, or globally via
  `npm i -g @microsoft/rayfin`).

### Deploy

```powershell
cd docs-site
npm install
npm run rayfin:deploy      # docusaurus build  ->  rayfin up (uploads build/)
```

`rayfin up` provisions static hosting + Fabric SSO and returns a public URL like
`https://<app>.webapp.fabricapps.net`. After the first deploy:

1. Add that origin to `allowedRedirectUris` in `rayfin/rayfin.yml`.
2. Re-run `npm run rayfin:up` so the SSO redirect is accepted.

> Rayfin publishes from an **authenticated Fabric CLI context**, not a
> `git push`. Run the deploy from a machine signed in to your tenant. (Fabric
> Apps is in preview; service-principal/CI automation may be limited.)

### Hosting config

`url` / `baseUrl` in `docusaurus.config.ts` are environment-driven and default
to Rayfin static hosting served at the domain root (`baseUrl: '/'`). No env vars
are needed for the Rayfin deploy above.

To build for a different host (e.g. GitHub Pages, or any static host), set both:

```powershell
$env:DOCS_URL = 'https://slavatrofimov.github.io'
$env:DOCS_BASE_URL = '/TimeIQ/'
npm run build
```

> ⚠️ GitHub Pages would make the docs **publicly readable** even from a private
> repo (unless you are on GitHub Enterprise Cloud with private Pages). Rayfin
> hosting is used here specifically to keep the docs private.

## Versioning (future)

Docusaurus supports per-guide versioning. When the first stable release is cut,
snapshot a guide with, for example:

```powershell
npm run docusaurus docs:version:user 1.0
```

Don't create version snapshots until a release is ready — they add maintenance
overhead.
